hero.headline:
A Peaceful Stay
in a Haven
of Serenity
hero.subheadline: A charming guesthouse set around a riad-inspired patio, 25 minutes from Marrakech.

home.welcome_body: Our rooms, arranged around a riad-inspired patio, offer a calm and enchanting setting. Admire the starry sky from the patio, enjoy the fireplace lounge and a dining room seating up to 14 guests. The ethnic, bohemian decor — sourced and customised by Marrakech artisans — creates a warm, elegant atmosphere.
home.rooms_sub: Each room is a world of its own: every hue was chosen to evoke unique emotions, in harmony with Marrakchi craftsmanship.
home.experiences_sub: Traditional hammam, massage room, fitness room, pétanque court, badminton and table tennis — plus the garden with its koi pond and Buddha statue.
home.cta_body: A room for the night or the entire villa — ideal for family gatherings, yoga retreats and seminars, sleeping up to 14.

rooms.page_sub: Five rooms around the patio, each with its own colour and character.

spa.page_sub: Traditional hammam, black-soap scrubs, massage room and fitness room — an oasis of relaxation and renewal.

events.page_sub: Hire the entire villa — sleeping 14 — for your yoga retreats, seminars, family reunions and celebrations.

gallery.page_sub: A visual journey through Villa Serena — its spaces, gardens, and light at every hour.

maison.page_sub: A peaceful, family-friendly stay in a haven of peace where nature and craftsmanship meet.
